**Answer – California Driver’s License Online Renewal**

Based on the **“Driver's License Online Renewal & Appointments”** information page (concept mockup):

> **Short answer: Many standard renewals can be completed online. Start in the Online Renewal area of the official agency site.**

**Check first – eligibility / what to have ready:**
* **Your renewal notice says if you are eligible to renew online.**
* Have your **license number, date of birth, and renewal notice nearby.**
* **If you need a new photo, test, or REAL ID upgrade, you may be asked to come in** for in-person renewal.

So: Yes – standard renewals are eligible for online renewal, and the starting point is the **Online Renewal area of the official agency site**, after confirming eligibility on your renewal notice. No further action / personal data entry was performed.
